name: Five-Star Review, the Song
why_it_works: Reviews are proof, but nobody reads them. Singing a real customer's own words as a soulful verse makes social proof entertaining, and hearing a stranger's praise in a heartfelt voice feels more sincere than any claim the business makes about itself.

hook.pattern: Show the plain review text on screen, then a voice starts singing it word for word.
examples: {{reviewer_first_name}} left us a review. So we sang it.
We turned a five-star review into a song.
This review was too good not to sing.

variables.name: reviewer_first_name
variables.description: Reviewer's first name or initial, used only with written permission

variables.name: review_line_one
variables.description: A full sentence from the real review, unedited; pick one that starts with a capital and sings in one breath (10 syllables or fewer)
variables.example: I used to dread the dentist

variables.name: review_line_two
variables.description: Another full sentence from the same review, unedited, 10 syllables or fewer
variables.example: Now I look forward to it

variables.name: review_hook
variables.description: The most singable 3-6 words lifted unchanged from the review, capitalized, 7 syllables or fewer

variables.name: first_visit_steps
variables.description: What a new customer's first visit really looks like, capitalized, 25 words or fewer
variables.example: Check-in takes five minutes, then a gentle cleaning, then a written plan with prices before anything else starts.

variables.name: offer
variables.description: Next step for new customers, capitalized, 6 words or fewer because it is spoken

beats.purpose: hook: the real review on screen
beats.voiceover: {{reviewer_first_name}} left us a review. So we sang it.

visual.prompt: Real screenshot of the actual five-star review, shown with written permission, vertical crop
Vertical slow push-in on a vintage microphone in a warm empty studio, soft amber light, no people, 9:16
Client-supplied photo of the welcoming entrance of {{brand}}, real staff with consent, natural daylight
Vertical close-up of a gold-lit vintage microphone with floating music notes, lyric space in the lower third

music.feel: warm soul gospel-lite, Rhodes piano, brushed snare, harmony on the hook

slides.headline: We sang a review
slides.body: Real words from {{reviewer_first_name}}, set to music. Swipe.
slides.visual_prompt: Title slide, five gold stars over a soft photo of a vintage microphone

slides.headline: Verse one
slides.visual_prompt: Lyric slide, review words in elegant serif type, warm amber background

slides.headline: Verse two
slides.visual_prompt: Lyric slide, same style, soft blurred warm interior behind the words

slides.headline: The chorus
slides.visual_prompt: Big type chorus slide, words repeated, music notes accent

slides.headline: How we found the hook
slides.body: No rewrites. We looped the words {{reviewer_first_name}} already stressed, so the rhythm was hers.
slides.visual_prompt: Simple diagram slide, the hook words with stressed syllables in bold and beat numbers above

slides.headline: What your first visit looks like
slides.visual_prompt: Clean three-step timeline graphic with icons, warm brand colors, plenty of space for text

slides.headline: Your words could be next
slides.visual_prompt: End card with {{brand}} logo, stars and the offer in large type

craft.technique: Found-lyric chorus (lift the hook from the customer's own words)
craft.notes: Keep the reviewer's words exactly; the songwriting is in phrasing, not rewriting. Pick short sentences that sing in one breath, about 8 syllables, and the 3-6 words that already carry a natural stress pattern (i LOOK for-WARD to it), then loop them as the chorus so the title is the customer's phrase. Sing the verse lines rubato with the last stressed syllable held over the bar line, then lock to a steady groove for the chorus. Tempo/feel: 76 BPM soul or gospel-lite, Rhodes piano, brushed snare, warm harmony on the repeated hook.

do_not: Edit, combine or invent review words; it must be a real, unpaid, verifiable review
Show a reviewer's face or full name without written consent
Pick a review that mentions a specific medical or financial result
Present the singer as the reviewer
compliance: All niches: use only real reviews with the reviewer's written permission; disclose if the reviewer received anything of value (FTC endorsement guides)
Dental and chiropractor: never reveal patient health information beyond what the patient authorized in writing (HIPAA); no claims of guaranteed or typical results
Financial advisor: testimonials must follow the SEC Marketing Rule (disclose whether the person is a client and any compensation); no performance or income claims
Real estate: include brokerage name and license info per state rules; no implied guaranteed sale price or timeline
The review screenshot and staff photos are real and client-supplied; never a generated reviewer, customer or staff member
